scope: Public issuer and reliable public-source data only. No bank logins or personalized offers accessed.

freedom.name: Chase Freedom Unlimited
updates: $200 new-cardmember bonus after $500 in purchases in the first 3 months.
0% intro APR on purchases and balance transfers for 15 months.
6 months complimentary DashPass when first activated by Dec. 31, 2027.
2% total cash back on qualifying Lyft purchases through Sept. 30, 2027.

prime.name: Prime Visa
updates: $150 Amazon Gift Card instantly loaded on approval for eligible Prime applicants.
5% back at Amazon.com, Audible.com, Whole Foods Market and Chase Travel with an eligible Prime membership; 2% at gas stations, restaurants and local transit/commuting; 1% elsewhere.

sourceNotes.source: Chase Amazon Visa/Prime Visa rewards terms

amazonstore.name: Amazon Store Card
updates: Public page currently advertises an Amazon Gift Card upon approval; the amount is not a fixed public value and should not be invented.
0% equal-monthly-payment financing is available on qualifying Amazon purchases: 6 months for $50-$599.99, 12 months for $600+, and 24 months on select purchases.
Eligible Prime Store Card members can choose 5% back at Amazon.com and Whole Foods Market instead of promotional financing; 5% back and financing cannot be combined.

smartly.name: U.S. Bank Smartly Visa Signature
updates: Unlimited 2% cash back on every purchase remains the base rate.
Qualifying Smartly Savings plus qualifying Smartly Checking/Safe Debit balances can raise the rate to 2.5%, 3% or 4% on the first $10,000 of eligible purchases per billing cycle.
0% intro APR on purchases and balance transfers for 12 billing cycles.
U.S. Bank rewards rules currently state an additional 4 points per $1 on prepaid hotel and car reservations through the Travel Center, for 6 points per $1 total on those qualifying purchases.

cashplus.name: U.S. Bank Cash+ Visa Signature
updates: $200 new-cardmember bonus after $1,000 in eligible purchases within 90 days.
0% intro APR on purchases and balance transfers for 15 billing cycles.
5% on the first $2,000 in combined purchases each quarter in two selected categories, 2% in one selected everyday category, and 1% elsewhere.
An additional 4% is earned on eligible prepaid air, car and hotel reservations through the U.S. Bank Travel Center, making 5% total on those qualifying Travel Center purchases.

sourceNotes.source: U.S. Bank Cash+ Visa Signature product page

quicksilver.name: Capital One Quicksilver Rewards
updates: $200 cash bonus after spending $500 within 3 months of opening an eligible Quicksilver account.
0% intro APR is currently advertised for the first 15 months.
1.5% cash back on every purchase, plus 5% on eligible Capital One Travel hotel/vacation rental/rental car/activity bookings and 5% on eligible Capital One Entertainment purchases.

platinum.name: Capital One Platinum
updates: No standard purchase rewards are advertised for the unsecured Platinum card; keep the rewards rate unconfigured rather than treating it as a cash-back card.
$0 annual fee and credit-building positioning remain current.
Capital One says eligible Platinum cardholders can be automatically considered for a credit-line increase in as little as six months.

discover.name: Discover it Cash Back
updates: Current Q3 2026 5% categories: Gas Stations, Transportation and Drug Stores through Sept. 30, 2026, on up to $1,500 in combined purchases after activation.
The card continues to earn 1% on other purchases and offers unlimited first-year Cashback Match for eligible new cardmembers.

sourceNotes.source: Discover it Cash Back product page

robinhoodgold.name: Robinhood Gold Card
updates: 3% cash back remains the standard rate on eligible purchases; 5% applies to eligible travel booked through the Robinhood travel portal.
The card requires an annual Robinhood Gold subscription; the card itself has no separate annual fee.

oldnavy.name: Old Navy Encore Credit Card
updates: All-Access Encore cardmembers earn 25 points per $1 at Old Navy/Gap family brands, 15 points per $1 at eligible outside apparel retailers and 5 points per $1 elsewhere on Mastercard; the published terms value 100 points at $1 in rewards, equivalent to 5%, 3% and 1% respectively.
A public 30% first-purchase discount is currently advertised for new Encore Credit Card accounts; the discount code expires 14 days after account opening and has exclusions.

bilt.name: Bilt Blue Rewards Card
updates: $100 Bilt Cash sign-up bonus is currently advertised for the Blue Card.

Current featured earning: up to 4X at Bilt partner restaurants, up to 3X on hotels through Bilt Travel, 3X on Lyft after linking accounts, 2X on flights through Bilt Travel, and 1X on other everyday purchases.
Housing rewards are currently advertised at up to 1.25X on rent and mortgage payments through Bilt, with no transaction fee on housing payments.
10% intro APR on new eligible purchases for the first 12 billing cycles.

dcu.name: DCU Visa Signature Cash Rewards
updates: Current DCU public materials confirm the Signature Cash Rewards card replaced the Platinum Rewards card and carries Visa Signature travel/lifestyle protections and services.
Current public page confirms no annual, balance-transfer, foreign-transaction or cash-advance fees, plus fraud notifications, freeze/unfreeze and Tap to Pay.
The configured 1% cash-back rate is retained based on DCU's published Signature Cash Rewards program materials; no higher standard public rate was found.

sourceNotes.source: DCU Visa Signature Cash Rewards product page
